title: 10 Best Allium Sativum Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Allium sativum are teas, tinctures, decoctions, capsules, and oils, each offering unique benefits for health. Garlic tea is commonly used to support immune function and digestion, while tinctures provide a concentrated form for quick absorption. Decoctions involve boiling garlic to extract its active compounds, enhancing its therapeutic properties. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized way to consume garlic regularly. Oils, such as garlic oil, are often used topically for skin conditions or to enhance the flavor of food.
